description: MAPA 40-2024 - Accord cadre à bons de commande d’entretien et de curage des réseaux d’eaux pluviales sur 4 ans is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Commune de Brignoles. Il s’agit d’un accord cadre à bons de commande conclu avec un seul opérateur économique sans montant minimum annuel de commande et avec un maximum annuel de 25 000 € HT. Il est renouvelable 3 fois par reconduction expresse et par période de 12 mois. La durée totale du marché est fixée à 48 mois. Coverage: Commune de Brignoles. The publisher named on the listing is Commune de Brignoles. The listing shows 1 download or service links in PDF. The listing shows 2024-11-18 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
